outcome_analysis: Efference is a Fall 2025 company run by a research founder, selling robot cameras and shared compute infrastructure. No verified funding, customers or exit were found. Hardware plus infrastructure is capital intensive and crowded with camera makers and data collection startups, so it is too early to judge.
